args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your Hawaii vacation itinerary (June 10-20, 2024), here's your complete packing list:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple pieces for beach days and water activities)
- Sunscreen (high SPF for tropical sun protection)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and dining)
- Camera (to capture memories)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach day at Waikiki Beach (June 11): Beach towel, flip flops, sunglasses
- Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay (June 12): Snorkel gear (or rent there), water shoes
- Hiking at Diamond Head (June 13): Hiking boots, water bottle, hat
- Visit to Pearl Harbor (June 14): Comfortable walking shoes, respectful attire
- Road trip to North Shore (June 15): Comfortable driving clothes, snacks
- Luau experience (June 16): Casual Hawaiian attire, light jacket
- Hotel spa day (June 17): Robe, slippers, relaxation essentials
- Kayaking at Kailua Beach (June 18): Quick-dry clothes, water shoes
- Shopping at Ala Moana Center (June 19): Comfortable shoes, shopping bags

Additional Recommendations:
- Light rain jacket (for tropical showers)
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Phone charger and power bank
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach bag or backpack
